section_summary.extract_value: This abstract describes a single study (Study X) examining the relationship between online interpersonal sexual objectification (OISO) experiences and intuitive eating in 1152 Chinese adolescent girls aged 11-15 years. The study measured OISO experiences, broad conceptualization of beauty, body appreciation, and intuitive eating through a questionnaire survey, and used structural equation modeling to test mediation pathways. Results indicated that OISO experiences negatively predicted intuitive eating through both broad conceptualization of beauty and body appreciation.
